|strategy=And, you thought [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] was the best all-around Dark Side character... When someone first said, "What about [[Feltipern Trevagg]] for your deck?" a few months ago I said, "Who the heck is that?"

[[Feltipern Trevagg{{!}}Trevagg]] is a dark-horse candidate whose stock has recently skyrocketed on the tournament scene. Why? Because he is an all around good card for card economy and versatility. Look what you get for a paltry two Force: 1) 2 power, 2) 4 destiny, 3) A warrior ([[Lone Warrior]]), 4) An alien (Moment of Triumph), 5) A bounty hunter (Res Luk La'Ruf), 6) Game text that makes battles more difficult at his location (except the trash compactor).

[[Feltipern Trevagg{{!}}Trevagg]] is a great character in just about any Dark Side deck. Early in the game, he can control a location, and with 3 different destiny adder cards that can target him, the Light Side is going to think twice before attacking a lone [[Feltipern Trevagg{{!}}Trevagg]] in the [[Tatooine: Cantina (Dark){{!}}Cantina]] (4 Force to boot, 6 if [[Presence Of The Force]]).

The main advantage to him is that 4 destiny. Numbers is still a prevalent Light Side strategy in today's tournament environment, and even if you have [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] out, as long as [[Feltipern Trevagg{{!}}Trevagg]] and Tech Mor are out with him, you have a destiny total of 11, which will minimize or eliminate the damage

Future prospects for Feltipern. Note that he is a "tax collector". Except for his game text and cancelling [[Garouf Lafoe]], nothing has yet been done with the game text.

Combos:

[[Feltipern Trevagg{{!}}Trevagg]] + [[Lone Warrior]] + [[Moment Of Triumph]] + Res Luk La-Rauf - A lonsome tax-collector can take out the likes of Ben &amp; [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] all by himself.

[[Feltipern Trevagg{{!}}Trevagg]] (in the [[Tatooine: Cantina (Dark){{!}}Cantina]]) + [[Presence Of The Force]] + [[Projective Telepathy]] - Make your opponent pay 8 force to initiate a battle in the [[Tatooine: Cantina (Dark){{!}}Cantina]]!<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20020612230535/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/dark/small/feltiperntrevagg.html</ref>
|rulings=* Resets the cost of initiating battle, cannot be further modified by cards like [[Wars Not Make One Great]].<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Feltipern%20Trevagg</ref>
* Anything allowing battle to be initiated for free ignores this cost.
* If inside a starship or enclosed vehicle, the number of Force icons present with [[Feltipern Trevagg{{!}}Trevagg]] is 0.
